name: cogos-harness
description: Portable Claude Code membrane for a CogOS node: session-lifecycle hooks, kernel-vitals proprioception, a compaction bypass path, a threads registry for open-ended waits, the cogos-kernel MCP server, and (0.4.0) one function-hooks module composing five mods (cog-redact, cog-guard, cog-context, cog-status, cog-receipt), all off unless ~/.cog/conf/harness-mods.json turns them on. Degrades to a no-op wherever the kernel or a cog workspace is absent.
